E0934

A trait constant value is not of its declared type

What

A trait constant value is not of its declared type

Why

The trait declares each constant's type, and each value has that type

Fix

Write a value of the declared type

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0934: tests/ui/trait_constant_wrong_type_e0934.stderr.

Error [jet.TraitConstantTypeMismatch]: The value of trait constant `sides` is not of type `Int`
  --> tests/ui/trait_constant_wrong_type_e0934.jet:11:14
    |
 11 |     sides :: "four"
    |              ^^^^^^
 Why: `Shape` declares `sides: Int`, and each value has that type
 Fix: Write a value of type `Int`
